slides.heading: Worth getting checked if
items: Pins and needles in the arm

caption:
Mr Turtle says he has no time to exercise. Hybi's answer: three neck moves, under two minutes, without leaving the chair.

1. Chin nods, ten slow reps. 2. Look over each shoulder, five each way, like checking your blind spot. 3. Hands behind your head, elbows wide, gently arch over the chair for three breaths, three times.

Two or three short rounds spread through the day usually beat one long session, so tie it to the end of each meeting.

Pins and needles down the arm, hand weakness, dizziness or a building headache are worth an assessment rather than more stretches. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can tailor a desk routine for you. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
